explanation: Generated a one-point eta-channel input with EtaMAID-2023 (model 3), full O(alpha) corrections, 6.53 GeV electron beam, recoil-proton detection, and the standard 0.166 GeV^2 vcut. The point is physical: using the masses hard-coded in eta/exclurad.F, the p+eta threshold is 1.486132 GeV, placing W=1.4885 GeV only 0.002368 GeV above threshold. At this W the code limits vcut internally to the kinematic vmax, approximately 0.00260026 GeV^2. Results may therefore be numerically sensitive near the vanishing final-state phase space and should be checked carefully.
